## Checklist
- [ ] Follows the lesson anatomy (`docs/pedagogy/lesson-anatomy.md`) and PPDAC headings
- [ ] New/changed dataset has a `DATASET_CARD.md` with a **verified licence** (`python tools/validate_dataset_cards.py`)
- [ ] No restricted data (DHS, microdata) and no personal data about real people
- [ ] Notebooks run top-to-bottom offline (`python tools/check_notebooks.py`)
- [ ] Units complete (`python tools/check_units.py`)
- [ ] Sources and credits included; AI help disclosed if used
- [ ] I agree my content is CC BY 4.0 and my code MIT

Labels to request: `grade-8`…`grade-12`, `dataset`, `translation`, `needs-teacher-review`
